title: gonolobus selloanus
intro: Gonolobus selloanus, commonly known as the Mexican wild yam, is a plant species native to Mexico and Central America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including treating menstrual disorders, menopausal symptoms, and other gynecological issues. The therapeutic actions of Gonolobus selloanus include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and estrogenic effects, which contribute to its ability to alleviate menstrual cramps and other symptoms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include diosgenin, a steroid saponin with estrogenic properties, and other triterpenoid saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
